seo.title: Massage near Wallkill, NY | Golden Practice
seo.description: Licensed massage serving Wallkill, NY — about 15 min from Brooklyn via Route 208. Transparent pricing, open every day.

richText.body: From the Wallkill area it's a relaxed fifteen-minute drive down Route 208 into town. Guests come from across the Wallkill River valley — some after a morning on the rail trail — for licensed therapists and the kind of published, no-surprise pricing that's hard to find nearby.
